summary: Verified Sales customer autocomplete + auto-save-to-master feature end-to-end. Backend: 11/11 pytest passed covering GET/POST/duplicate/case-insensitive/empty-name on /api/inventory/customers plus full sale-with-new-customer, sale-with-existing-customer (no double create), and 'Umum' no-master-write flow. Frontend Playwright verified datalist#sale-customers-list populated (2 options), input list='sale-customers-list' attribute present, phone auto-fill from master on name match ('Bu Ani QA' → 08111222333), '◉ Pelanggan terdaftar' blue badge for matching name, [data-testid=new-customer-indicator] green badge for new name, no badge for 'Umum' or empty. Full E2E: submitting sale with new customer created row in /api/inventory/customers (count 2→3) with correct phone; toast 'tersimpan ke Master' appeared. Regression: /api/sales, /api/sales/stats/today, customer enrichment (order_count, total_revenue) all healthy.

issues: React dev-only hydration warning: '<span> cannot be child of <option>' — caused by Emergent editor's x-file-name instrumentation wrapping option content with <span data-ve-dynamic>. Not a real bug in Sales.jsx (option children are plain strings). Harmless in production build but noisy in dev console.

critical_code_review_comments: Sales.jsx auto-save is fire-and-forget with silent catch (line 264 `catch (_err) {}`). If backend POST /inventory/customers fails for a legitimate reason (e.g., 500), user gets no warning. Consider a subtle toast.warn on failure so ops can retry-create in Master tab. Non-blocking though.

isExistingCustomer() and onCustomerNameChange() both do the same case-insensitive lookup — extract into a useMemo of `activeCustomers.map(c => c.name.toLowerCase())` for O(1) lookup and DRY. Trivial optimization for a small list but improves readability.

Sales.jsx datalist option children combine phone + contact_person as inner text — some browsers (Safari) don't display <option> body text inside <datalist>. Since value=c.name is what users see in Chrome/Firefox dropdown, this is OK, but consider adding phone into a `label` attribute for wider compatibility.
Backend cust_create uses case-insensitive regex duplicate check with re.escape — correct and safe. No injection risk.

Backend cust_list enriches every response with order_count/total_revenue by scanning ALL job_orders each call (potentially slow at scale). For >1000 orders consider MongoDB aggregation with $group, or caching. Non-blocking for current scale.

server.py file is 4711 lines — well past the 700-line guideline. Should be split into modules (auth, sales, inventory, payroll…) for maintainability. Long-standing issue, not introduced by this feature.

No unit test for concurrent duplicate POST /customers race (two requests same name at same instant may both pass the pre-check). Extremely unlikely in a single-user kiosk POS but worth a unique index on customers.name (case-insensitive) at Mongo level.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (datalist populated, list attr present, auto-fill phone works, both badges toggle correctly, E2E sale + auto-save + master upsert verified, cleanup successful)

seed_data_creation: Test customer 'Bu Ani QA' (phone 08111222333) created temporarily for autocomplete verification and deleted after test. All TEST_QA_* prefixed sales and customers created by pytest are auto-cleaned in module teardown fixture. Verified final state: 1 customer 'PT Test Advertising' (order_count=1, total_revenue=750000) — unchanged from pre-test state.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Feature fully validated. Datalist autocomplete pattern in NewSaleModal (Sales.jsx lines 286-302) works: input[list=sale-customers-list] + <datalist id=sale-customers-list><option value=name/></datalist>. Phone auto-fill triggered on both onChange and onBlur via onCustomerNameChange (line 193-199) with case-insensitive exact-match lookup. Two badges: '◉ Pelanggan terdaftar' (blue) for existing match, '✓ Pelanggan baru' (green, testid=new-customer-indicator) for new. Auto-save happens in submit() line 254-265 as fire-and-forget POST /api/inventory/customers with silent catch — sale never fails if customer save fails. Backend /api/inventory/customers POST rejects duplicates (case-insensitive regex) with 400, so re-submitting existing customer is naturally idempotent. 'Umum' and empty names are excluded from auto-save. If main agent wants stronger guarantee, could add Mongo unique index on lowered(name).
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — this iteration validated a new feature, no bugs found. Feature implementation clean and matches spec.
